purpose: Development comparison only, no tuning or acceptance holdout
selection: Both full comp DEV recordings already declared in validation/real-audio/manifest.json; never inspect or run holdout
truth: Original JAMS performed chords and per-string MIDI note intervals, unchanged

accompaniment.license: CC0-1.0, locally authored synthesis dedicated by this validation script
accompaniment.harmony: C major, A minor, F major, G major cycling every 4 seconds, deliberately independent of guitar

metrics.chordRootAgreement: correct root frames / nonempty performed-chord reference frames
metrics.majorMinorAgreement: correct root and maj/min frames / reference maj/min frames (extended reference chords excluded)
metrics.noteF1: micro exact-MIDI frame-set F1 on union of mono/poly predictions; no octave forgiveness
metrics.siSdr: zero-mean scale-invariant SDR versus clean guitar after equal-length mono decode, no lag optimization

resources: Six-minute input repeats first full mixed fixture then trims to exactly 360s; backend focus=guitar; local and runtime container --cpus=2 --memory=4g, sequential
report: Per-fixture and pooled numerator/denominator counts, raw result and audio hashes, commands, wall/CPU/peak RSS/disk, failures retained. No required improvement threshold and no model/recognizer tuning.
